'''Leticia Gutierrez-Ablaza''' (born 1972 or 1973) is an American politician. A member of the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]], she is the member-elect for the [[United States House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|TX|9}}.

Gutierrez was born in Mexico, in 1972 or 1973.<ref name=2013council>{{cite web|title=Infrastructure critical concern for District I candidates|url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/houston/article/Infrastructure-critical-concern-for-District-I-4905680.php|date=October 17, 2013|publisher=Houston Chronicle|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Community Fellows|url=https://ces.rice.edu/community-fellows|publisher=Rice University Humanities and Arts Center for Environmental Studies|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> She graduated from [[Milby High School]], located in the [[East End, Houston|East End]] of [[Houston]], and the [[University of St. Thomas (Texas)|University of St. Thomas]].<ref name=fox26/> She worked as a community outreach organizer for Air Alliance Houston.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://defendernetwork.com/people/dn-news-profiles/black-hispanic-environmental-justice-houston/|title=Leticia Gutierrez: Frontline environmental justice warrior|first=Aswad|last=Walker|date=January 25, 2024}}</ref> Gutierrez also served as chief of staff to Houston City Council member [[Helena Brown (politician)|Helena Brown]] until her resignation in April 2012.<ref name=chron26>{{cite web|title=He's a working class kid who went to space. She's running under a new name. Who will win in the Hispanic 9th? |url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/opinion/outlook/article/district-9-election-vote-race-mealer-terry-virts-21367711.php|last=Lankenau|first=Regina|publisher=Houston Chronicle|date=February 20, 2026|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=2 top members of Brown's staff resign|url=https://www.chron.com/news/houston-texas/article/2-top-members-of-brown-s-staff-resign-3504233.php|last=Moran|first=Chris|date=April 23, 2012|publisher=Houston Chronicle|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> Gutierrez was also an unsuccessful candidate for Houston City Council in 2011 and 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=Local election results|url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/article/local-election-results-2259506.php|date=November 8, 2011|publisher=Houston Chronicle|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref><ref name=2013council /><ref name=chron26 />

Gutierrez ran in the 2026 election for the [[United States House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|TX|9}}. She defeated [[Alex Mealer]] in the general election.<ref name=fox26>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fox26houston.com/news/alex-mealer-concedes-leticia-gutierrez-texas-9th-congressional-district-race|title=Alex Mealer concedes to Leticia Gutierrez in Texas' 9th Congressional District race|first=Ronnie|last=Marley|date=November 3, 2026|publisher=FOX 26 Houston|website=FOX 26 Houston}}</ref>
